figures.caption: Figure 1: Two channels of a state acting on the choice probability pi(z) = F{Mi(z)/σi(z)}, plotted against the systematic margin Mi (baseline scale held fixed). Solid: before the intervention; dashed: after. Left: a mean-shifting state, Mi 7→ Mi + ℓi ∆z with σi fixed, translates the curve horizontally, so responsiveness is one-sided. Right: an information refinement, σ′ i < σi with Mi fixed, steepens the curve, pivoting it around p = 1/2 at Mi = 0: take-up rises for Mi > 0 and falls for Mi < 0, so responsiveness is two-sided.
